en.topic_title: Woman arrested for alleged sedition outside court ahead of Tiananmen vigil group’s national security case verdict
en.topic_summary:
Hong Kong police arrested a woman for alleged sedition outside the West Kowloon Law Courts Building on Friday, hours before leaders of a Tiananmen vigil group were found guilty under the national security law.



Hong Kong police set up a cordon outside the West Kowloon Law Courts Building on August 21, 2026, ahead of the verdict hearing of the trial of two Tiananmen vigil activists Chow Hang-tang and Lee Cheuk-yan on national security charges. Photo: Kyle Lam/HKFP.
